title: Load the recent patterns at the start of every session
description: At the start of a session, call the boot route to get the rules and the most recent patterns.
root_cause: Other agents or earlier sessions may have changed things since you last looked.
diagnosis_steps:
Call once, before the first action: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" <BASE_URL>/api/v1/memory/boot
The answer has two lists: rules (full text, validated only) and recent (short form, latest first). Read the rules, skim the recent list, open (GET /api/v1/memory/<id>) the ones that touch today's work.
quick_fix: Read the rules, skim the recent list, open the ones that touch today's work.
root_fix: Do this once per session, before the first action.
